description: A ready citation for one atlas record (compound, target or condition) or for the atlas as a whole: the canonical url, the citation line, a BibTeX entry, the version, the original papers to cite for its findings (PubMed links) and the licence (CC BY 4.0 with attribution).

id.description: A record id or name, for example "compound:cbd", "CB1" or "epilepsy". Leave out to cite the atlas.

name: cite
title: Cite an atlas record
